external.label: local run, 18 Nov 2026
external.note: 164 HumanEval tasks (MIT), judged by EvalPlus HumanEval+ tests (Apache-2.0) as an outside oracle. Figures are taken from bench/external/results.json (aethens 0.1.0.dev0, seed 0, budget standard, exhaustive mutation on), committed on 18 Nov 2026. C003 was not run (HumanEval has no labelled candidates). C007 was not run (the verifier is Aethens' own unittest conversion, so probe results would describe the converter, not HumanEval). 20 tasks whose original canonical solution fails the HumanEval+ oracle are excluded from C004 precision and recall. C004 precision is low: many mutants that HumanEval accepts are also accepted by HumanEval+, so a surviving mutant is not by itself evidence of a weak test.
